item.text: The current hasher stores opaque `maphash.Seed` values, which cannot be recreated from a supplied string. I’ll store per-ID seed strings, use a deterministic hash for seeded values, and keep automatic initialization and reseeding.

The implementation now accepts explicit seed strings, and hash functions read the current seed on each call so restoring one takes effect. I’ve added tests for reseeding, restoring, cross-instance consistency, and the package-level `SetSeed`. I’ll format the files and run the hasher tests.

item.text:
Implemented deterministic per-ID seeding in [hasher.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher.go). `SetSeed` now produces repeatable hashes for the same input, reseeding changes the result, and restoring a seed restores the original result. Seed access is synchronized.

Added regression coverage in [hasher_test.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go). The hasher, database, and persistence tests pass; the hasher race test passes too.
